about: Upper limits of the bundles' sizes (tools/ci_checks.py sizes, CI). Set about 10 % above the sizes after the vias-in-3D merge and the channel export with its LTspice bench and export settings (2026-10-25: kisi.html 3.20 MB, kisi-examples.html 6.83 MB, kisi.mjs 2.54 MB; before them 2.87 / 6.50 / 2.22 MB). A change that makes a bundle larger on purpose raises the limit in the same commit.
